scope: September 30 autopilot computer games; no Ladder Log entries

videos.owner_visible_core: Torchic / Mega Blaziken ex; Castform Sunny Form
videos.useful_finding: Rare Candy development and repeated Fire reattachments; U-turn damage then switch. Burn messages follow zero HP and do not establish burn-damage knockouts.

videos.owner_visible_core: Alolan Vulpix / Alolan Ninetales ex; Team Rocket's Raticate ex; Elegant Cape
videos.useful_finding: Binding Snow's restriction icon persists through knockout/promotion while AI attaches Energy to its Bench. Sightseer reveals no Stage1 and adds none. Raticate evolves against zero-Energy Crocalor, so no theft is established.

Backpack played before evolution boosts Heliolisk's Bench damage to30. Final Active and Bench knockouts award +2 while the display shows three circles. Elegant Cape on Basic Electrike gives no immediate HP gain.

videos.owner_visible_core: Passimian ex / Toxicroak; Roggenrola / Boldore / Gigalith ex
videos.useful_finding: After Passimian's attack-damage knockout, Offload Pass moves its two Fighting to Toxicroak, enabling the immediate winning counterattack. Electrike reaches zeroHP from direct Poison Jab damage before the Poisoned announcement.

Metallic Turbo develops two separate Bench recipients. Big Malasada heals10; Dialga's settled HP follows150 to100 to110 to50. Two30-damage Turbo attacks and two100-damage Heavy Impacts match the260-damage result. Condition removal was not tested.

videos.owner_visible_core: Hitmonchan ex / Passimian ex / Rhyhorn / Rhydon / Rhyperior
videos.opponent: AI Alolan Muk Deck (Deluxe Pack: Mega)
videos.useful_finding: Quick Straight visibly excludes Weakness. Six50-damage attacks match300 result damage; Hitmonchan ends at40HP. Four reserve Fighting are on Rhyperior and the final attachment goes to Passimian. Potion remains unused and no Sleep is applied.

Evolution preserves Growlithe's accumulated damage, leaving Arcanine ex at 110 HP. Two Inferno Onrush attacks each cause 20 recoil; Arcanine finishes at 50 HP. Only three Fire are attached, with turn 8's generated Fire unused. Four attacks match 360 result damage.

videos.owner_visible_core: Hitmonchan ex / Cubone / Marowak ex / Drilbur / Excadrill
videos.useful_finding: Auto retreats the surviving Hitmonchan into Excadrill for the last knockout and loses Hitmonchan's one Energy. Quick Straight could already defeat the visible 10 HP target, so the retreat is unnecessary for that immediate win. Four attacks of 50 plus Mud Shot's 70 match 270 result damage.

videos.owner_visible_core: Castform Sunny Form / Torchic / Mega Blaziken ex / Heatmor
videos.opponent: AI Mega Sceptile ex & Meowscarada ex Deck (Deluxe Pack: Mega)
videos.useful_finding: Auto removes its own Hiking Trail before Copycat. Flower Trick marks the Active spot; its marker stays there when Mega Blaziken replaces Castform. The battle ends before delayed 70 damage resolves. Mega Burning deals 140, discards one Fire and earns two points; Burn follows an already established knockout.

videos.result_display: Loss; 1-3 circles shown, final opponent +2 award
videos.owner_visible_core: Articuno ex / Froakie / Greninja ex / Mudkip / Marshtomp
videos.opponent: AI Mega Blaziken ex & Typhlosion ex Deck (Deluxe Pack: Mega)
videos.useful_finding: Mega's first attack deals 120, then Burn deals 20; recovery clears Burn without refunding damage. Lucky Ice Pop heals twice, bringing Greninja from 30 to 70. Red-boosted Aqua Edge and Ice Wing leave Mega at 10 HP. Both owner ex knockouts come from direct attacks, with the final +2 award shown beside a three-circle HUD.

videos.owner_visible_core: Mudkip / Mega Swampert ex / Froakie / Frogadier
videos.opponent: AI Mega Blaziken ex & Typhlosion ex Deck (Deluxe Pack: Mega)
videos.useful_finding: Mega Swampert's 150-damage knockout discards two of its own Water. Typhlosion's three heads remove only the two available Water, while later tails removes none. Swampert never rebuilds to its three-Water attack cost and its single knockout awards the opponent three points. Research draws Rare Candy, which is held rather than played.

videos.result_display: Win; 3-1 circles shown, final ex knockout
videos.owner_visible_core: Greninja / Greninja ex / Mega Slowbro ex
videos.opponent: AI Mega Blaziken ex & Typhlosion ex Deck (Deluxe Pack: Mega)
videos.useful_finding: Typhlosion flips five heads but removes only Greninja ex's two available Water. Shifting Stream then brings in the accumulating Mega Slowbro. Irida heals only the energized Slowbro, and its final two-head attack damages both opposing Bench Pokemon without knocking either out.

videos.owner_visible_core: Alolan Geodude / Graveler / Golem; Electrike / Mega Manectric ex; Electrical Cord
videos.opponent: AI Mega Blastoise ex & Wailord ex Deck (Deluxe Pack: Mega)
videos.useful_finding: Electrical Cord adds one Lightning to the lone Benched Electrike after Graveler is knocked out, taking it from one Energy to two. Both Generators flip tails. Auto is visibly unchecked during those plays, so they are not attributed to the automatic policy. Mega Manectric scales damage from its own earned points.

videos.owner_visible_core: Riolu; Scratch Drilbur / Headbutt Bounce Drilbur; Garchomp ex and Mega Lucario ex held
videos.opponent: AI Mega Manectric ex & Bellibolt ex Deck (Deluxe Pack: Mega)
videos.useful_finding: Two different Drilbur versions deal different damage. Arena of Antiquity is drawn and held. Its visible Fighting bonus supports a conditional final attack of70 instead of the observed50 against Bellibolt ex70HP, which would produce an immediate knockout if played first under the shown conditions. That alternative was not executed and does not establish an eventual win.

videos.owner_visible_core: Passimian ex / Rocky Helmet; Mega Lucario ex and Gabite held
videos.opponent: AI; visible Heliolisk / Mega Manectric ex / Bellibolt ex
videos.useful_finding: Arena, Korrina and weakness raise Seismic Toss from60 to130, but the boosted Mega Manectric survives at60HP. Its next80damage knocks out the sole Passimian; Helmet still reduces the attacker to40. The owner loses with1-2 points because no Pokemon remains in play.
